text: Solo: Condemnation, Chain of Torment, Earth's Retribution, Judgment Thunder, Divine Aura and Bolt to 10, damage before heals.
detail: At 36 (about 147 points): those at 10 with Bolt at 8, Debilitating Mark 8, the rest in Healing Light.

text: Solo stigmas: Earth Punishment, Light of Protection, Noble Aura now; Prayer of Amplification at 37.
detail: Earth Punishment level 5 first: it makes Condemnation crit and lose its cooldown.

text: Dungeons: heals to 10 first, Light of Protection and Earth Punishment, Summon Resurrection until the group stops dying.
detail: Swap Light of Protection for Absolution when a Chanter brings Undefeated Mantra.

text: Macro: bind it, hold it with left click, 10 ms delay; cooldown skills at the bottom of each column.
detail: Entries are hotbar columns; the bottom skill of a column is tried first.

text: Never macro Light of Protection or Bolt: the loop turns the toggle off and fires Bolt uncharged.
Unconfirmed: whether the editor runs its entries top-down or bottom-up. Check in game before trusting step order.
detail: allthings.how says top to bottom; mein-mmo says bottom up.

text: Korean guides assume 5–6 stigma slots and level 50: take their logic, not their numbers.
